opponent_table.note: meanK and its centering constant come from the SAME pull. The published table in claude/mlb-opponent-database.md needs an interactive browser session to rebuild and lags by a slate at a time; this one rebuilds nightly. Measured 2026-08-23 the two agree to a mean |dE[K]| of 0.021 K, max 0.064 K.

board_rule: Sam's filter, not Claude's: pitchers and hitters each have their own 25 seats, and neither kind takes the other's. Hitters: up to 25 whose record beats the price's break-even. Pitchers: every pitcher prop whose number beats the price's break-even comes first; any seats left are filled with the best remaining pitcher props by that number, each marked as losing to its price, never both sides of one prop. Everything reads by confidence, highest first. 3 pitcher and 153 hitter rows were priced; 28 are shown: 3 pitcher (3 below their price) and 25 hitter.
hitter_note: Hitter rows carry NO confidence rating and NO band. There is no hitter model in this project, and ledger rule 55 forbids a MARKET number from carrying a Gizmo's confidence %. Their number is the player's own season rate at that exact line with a Jeffreys prior — DESCRIPTIVE, not a projection. A real hitter model is the next build.
coverage: 28 plays across 1 games, ranked by blend. 0 pairs clear the 1.8x floor. Generated unattended from the collector's own data -- no human chose which plays appear. This card is 2026-10-08 only: 18 priced row(s) for 2026-10-11 wait for that day's own card, so a thin day shows fewer rows rather than filling seats from another day.
calibration_warning: under-60 hit 51% against a claimed 56.2% (-5.2 pts, n=243); 60-70 hit 50.5% against a claimed 64.2% (-13.7 pts, n=418); 70-80 hit 57.5% against a claimed 73.7% (-16.2 pts, n=153); 80-plus hit 56.9% against a claimed 87% (-30.2 pts, n=51). The under-60 band is currently the closest to its own claim. 865 graded plays behind these figures and small samples throughout -- every one of them will move.
selection_note: Nothing here is a recommendation to bet. Every qualifying pitcher prop on the board is printed with its failing numbers attached (ledger rule 53); which of them to bet is Sam's call. The one thing withheld is a PAIR below 1.8x, which is his own instruction.
shadow_note: `blend` is the carded estimate and the ONLY column that enters calibration. `carried` is the blend after the T21/T22 flags -- both PRE-REGISTERED AND NOT ADOPTED -- and enters no denominator. It is a shadow ladder kept so the September re-fit can measure whether the flagged number would have won.

top10_rule: Most likely to hit, among rows priced at -400 or longer. Sam's instruction, 2026-08-26: likely AND payable. The pool is EVERY priced row plus EVERY alt ladder rung -- rungs never reach picks[] at all -- deduped to one row per player, then ranked by the confidence that row already carries. ⛔ This is NOT picks[:10]: different pool, different gate, different dedup.

parlay_meta.note: 92 priced leg(s) never entered a combination. The pool takes the 12 highest-confidence legs from each of 5 PRICE BANDS rather than the top 60 overall, because confidence and price move together and a confidence-ranked pool contains only short favourites — which cannot multiply to 3x in three legs at all. Stated rather than hidden.

why: The game model gives Chicago White Sox 62% to cover +1.5. It expects 3.5 runs to 4.1, with Hagen Smith starting against Parker Messick. The price -182 needs 64.5%.
The game model gives Cleveland Guardians 56% to win. It expects 4.1 runs to 3.5, with Parker Messick starting against Hagen Smith. The price -112 needs 52.8%.

game_lines_meta.totals: not on the card (Sam, 2026-10-03); mlb-game-model.json only

game_lines_rule: The game model's side of each 2026-10-08 game with both starters named, for the moneyline and the run line, at 50% or more and -400 or longer at the best of the five books, by its chance, at most 25. A row is frozen once its game starts.
parlay_rule: Two-leg combinations pay 1.8x or more and three- and four-leg combinations pay 3x or more, with no upper limit -- Sam's bands, 2026-09-22. The floors are never crossed, and every list is ranked by its chance to land, highest first. Legs are Hard Rock only (the only book of the five that multiplies), never below the -700 price floor, and always in DIFFERENT GAMES checked on GAME ID rather than on opponent name (ledger rule 54). ⛔ No same-game parlays: legs inside one game are correlated and books reprice them.
projection_note: Keyed pid|market|side|line. On a PITCHER row it is the central outcome that would produce the confidence shown beside it, inverted through the same distribution that row assumes, so the two can never disagree. On a HITTER row for hits, home runs or RBIs it is the same inversion of his own record. On TOTAL BASES and HITS+RUNS+RBIs it is his own per-game MEAN -- T34/T35 fitted three distributions and none reproduced that mean to the 0.25 bar, so the mean itself is used, which reproduces it exactly.
schema_note: picks[] are the standard lines, ranked by blend, each carrying its Hard Rock alt ladder in .ladder with every rung priced through the same model. pairs[] may use any rung. Every price is Hard Rock's own, from a us2 pull, at the minute stamped above.
